**Finding submitted — deviation (MFN), preferred-level cure.**

- **Responsive locations inspected:** § 7.2 (p0026) is the only MFN-type obligation in the document; targeted searches for "favourable", "match", "most-favoured" returned no other hits. § 12.3 (p0044) contains Vendor's acknowledgement that Customer has made no most-favoured-customer commitment, and no Vendor-granted MFN in our favour exists anywhere.
- **Direction:** § 7.2 burdens us — we must disclose and match better third-party offers for Vendor's benefit. Open-ended (no defined product, no 12-month limit, no like-for-like carve-outs), so it fails all three fallback elements and sits in walk-away territory, and it conflicts with § 12.3.
- **Cure:** single surgical replace of the offending sentence in § 7.2, negating the obligation operator ("Customer has no obligation to disclose or match…"), which meets the sole preferred element and removes the internal contradiction with § 12.3 without touching unrelated fee terms.
